title: Inherit the Winds Anime Gets Advanced 2-Week Screening in Japanese Theaters Starting on November 13
content: The staff for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) announced on Friday that the anime will get an advanced two-week screening in Japanese theaters starting on November 13. The advanced screening will center on the protagonist Tachikawa Jinsuke.
author: ANN

title: Medalist Manga Goes on Hiatus
content: The official X/Twitter account for Tsurumaikada 's Olympic ice-skating manga Medalist announced on Friday that the manga will go on hiatus due to "production circumstances." The announcement did not reveal when the manga would resume.
author: ANN

title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat Season 3 Reveals New Trailer, Visual, Cast, September 27 Premiere
content: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 3 revealed the second key visual and trailer, along with new cast members and a September 27, 2026 premiere date.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring Anime Reveals Main Trailer and 3 Versions, October 4 Premiere
content: The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring anime revealed the main trailer, along with an October 4 premiere date in Japan. Advance streaming through AnimeFesta is scheduled to begin on September 11. The anime will be available in three versions in Japan with different levels of censorship.
author: Anime Corner

title: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner Reveals New Trailer, Visual, Cast and Theme Songs
content: I’m Dating a Dark Summoner anime has revealed its second key visual and trailer, along with additional cast members and theme songs. The anime will premiere on October 4, 2026 in Japan, while HIDIVE previously confirmed a streaming license.
author: Anime Corner

title: The World’s Finest Assassin Season 2 Reveals Main Trailer, Key Visual, Cast, January 2027 Release
content: The World’s Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat Season 2 anime revealed the main key visual and trailer, along with additional cast and a January 2027 release date. The anime previously confirmed a 2027 release date with a teaser video .
author: Anime Corner

title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Cour 2 Reveals Trailer, Theme Songs, Key Visual, October 11 Premiere
content: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 anime revealed a trailer for its Cour 2, which is set to release in October 2026. Studio SILVER LINK returned to animate, with twelve episodes released in the first part. The anime previously revealed a teaser .
author: Anime Corner

title: Noragami's Adachitoka Launches New Manga
content: The October issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Magazine announced on Friday manga duo Adachitoka will launch a new manga titled Yadoya no Oinu-sama (The Inn's Dog) in the next issue on October 6. Adachitoka posted a preview image of the manga on their X/Twitter account on Friday.
author: ANN

title: 'Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru 3rd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, New Staff, Second Promo
content: • The official website for Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru 3rd Season ( As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 3 ) television anime revealed additional cast, new staff, a second key visual (pictured), and the second promotional video Friday.
author: MyAnimeList
